OET SAMPLE TEST: MEDICINE


ROLEPLAYER CARD


SETTING      Suburban General Practice


MOTHER / FATHER
You are the mother/father of 7-year-old Cody who has problems sitting
still and concentrating. He often breaks items accidentally. He has been
getting into trouble at school because of his behaviour and you are very
worried. You believe he is suffering ADHD and have heard that the drug,
Ritalin, will fix his condition. You have brought Cody to your GP’s clinic for
a consultation regarding your son’s condition and for a prescription for this
drug or similar.


TASK
   •   When asked, tell the doctor that you feel that Cody is suffering
       attention-deficit syndrome
   •   Briefly answer the doctor’s questions about your reasons for this.
       Stress your worry about the consequences of his poor behaviour and
       progress at school.
   •   Answer the doctor’s questions about his diet.
   •   Tell the doctor you’ve heard that non-drug treatments are
       ineffective. Several of your friends highly recommend Ritalin for
       quick effective treatment of their children.
   •   Reluctantly agree to a full examination of the boy before any
       treatments are prescribed.
